scope: Real pretrained correctness subsets using existing SFT; not full task benchmarks or full-epoch WTS. All local cases use A10080, FP32 adapter parameters, BF16 base except model-owned physical precision. Shared CPU/disk timings are not throughput benchmarks. Merged exports compare against a private FP32 portable reference. FP32 conversion is not guaranteed to preserve BF16 decisions: the native 30B MoE LoRA case changes 6/64 controlled greedy positions versus BF16, despite FP32 merge equivalence and exact BF16 portable reload.
